task.description: Implement EXT-03 according to src/design/ext-03-plugin-interface.md. Add stable in-process plugin interface and startup-only registration support for custom node type handlers. Ensure handler invocation receives current instance context (variables and node config) and supports only COMPLETE (optional output variables) and ERROR (reason) outcomes. Enforce plugin-over-built-in precedence when node type matches. Implement panic-safe invocation mapping caught panic to ERROR path and route all plugin ERROR outcomes through existing EE-10 error handling. Wire COMPLETE output variable handling to existing EE-09 merge semantics, including non-object output as error path. Enforce startup-only registration (registry freeze after bootstrap) and reject post-freeze registration. Implement API version compatibility checks for plugin interface stability boundaries. Update/add tests to cover registration lifecycle, precedence shadowing, panic mapping, and EE-09/EE-10 integration for EXT-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases. Run mandatory validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set check before completion.
acceptance_criteria: zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate exit 0
Plugin registration is startup-only and rejected after registry freeze
Plugin handlers shadow built-in handlers for same node type
Handler outcomes COMPLETE/ERROR are enforced and panic is mapped to ERROR/EE-10
COMPLETE output variable merge follows EE-09 and invalid output routes to EE-10
Design traceability for EXT-03 is satisfied by implementation and tests

result.summary: Implemented EXT-03 plugin interface and registration lifecycle with startup freeze controls, integrated plugin-over-built-in SERVICE_TASK precedence in runtime execution, mapped plugin invocation/errors through EE-10, and applied EE-09 merge validation semantics for plugin COMPLETE output including invalid-output error routing.
